finish_message: Phase 4 multi-document study sets, workspace tabs, synchronized navigation, MarginNote import action, and Markdown/OPML exporters are complete and pushed.
summary: Added topic document attach/detach/query APIs, Markdown and OPML hierarchy exporters, selected-study-set state, multi-document PDF tabs with attach/detach controls, automatic card-driven document switching and PDF jumps, workspace mode controls with keyboard shortcuts, MarginNote 3 import and Markdown/OPML export actions, and StudySet tests.
notes: The implementation targets macOS SwiftUI/AppKit/PDFKit. The available execution environment here does not provide the macOS SDK, so swift test and swift build were not run locally; the orchestrator should run both validation commands on macOS.
